name: Coordinator Responds Directly to User
description:
Fires when a coordinator loop calls decide(action=respond_direct, reason=<user-facing prose>). The persona contract overloads `reason` for this action: it carries the prose to deliver to the user, NOT an internal log — same overload pattern as ask_user (see 03-ask-user.json). This rule publishes that prose on the user-response bus (user.response.<coordinator_loop_id>) and stamps a coordinator.clarification.reply triple for audit. Downstream channel routers (UI, email, SMS) subscribe to user.response.> and adapt for their wire format.

Fires for BOTH the front-door respond_direct case (small-talk, meta question, simple-answer routing per 20-delegation-rules.md §4) AND the chain-terminal wake-up case (coordinator spawned by 04a-/04b- rules after a chain reaches its terminal, synthesising the chain result into a user-facing reply). The rule shape is identical for both — the wake-up coordinator's `reason` is the synthesised answer.

Coordinator-redesign Slice 1c. Mirror of 03-ask-user.json's shape; the only difference is the action-value gate and the audit-triple predicate name.

metadata.channel_agnostic: Mirror of 03-ask-user.json — see that file's metadata for the full channel-router contract. user.response.<loop_id> is the framework's user-response bus; channel-type prefix is a future slice.
metadata.reason_overload_note: Persona contract (10-decision-contract.md) overloads `reason` for action=respond_direct to carry user-facing prose, parallel to action=ask_user. The wake-up coordinator (spawned by 04a-/04b-) writes its synthesised chain-result answer in `reason`; the front-door coordinator (handling small-talk or simple answers) does the same. Slice 1c is when respond_direct's `reason` becomes user-facing — Slice 1 left it on the floor.
metadata.audit_triple_distinction: coordinator.clarification.reply is the audit triple for respond_direct prose; coordinator.clarification.question (03-ask-user.json) is the audit triple for ask_user prose. Distinct predicates so a graph query can isolate clarifying-question turns from reply turns without parsing the loop's terminal action.
metadata.publish_properties_omission_note: Same wire-shape constraint as 03-ask-user.json: publish action's properties are NOT variable-substituted by upstream executePublish. The wakeup signal is therefore subject-only; subscribers graph-query the audit triple (coordinator.clarification.reply) for the prose. Upstream PR target: substitutePayloadVariables on Properties inside executePublish.
metadata.open_followup: v1 ships the wakeup signal + audit triple; UI consumer hookup follows in a separate slice (same as 03-ask-user.json's open follow-up). Operators can `nats sub 'user.response.>'` to verify; `nats kv get ENTITY_STATES <loop_entity_id>` to read the audit triple.
